data.value: With a PIN, BorgStudio is locked at start and after a while without use, and passphrases are kept encrypted with a key derived from the PIN. Without the PIN nobody can read them – not even BorgStudio. A forgotten PIN cannot be recovered: then only resetting the vault (the passphrases in it are lost) or importing an export helps.
